OptogeneticsConfig.description:
Zapit optogenetic stimulation (names Pip's, 9 Nov 2026; av-dome's stimDelay, excludeRepeats and
pseudorandomSelection dropped: a delay must be 0, there are no repeat trials, and draws are always balanced).

The stimulation sites and ramp-down are set in the Zapit conditions file loaded in Zapit, not here; the laser
power is laser_power_mw, sent with every laser-on trial's StartStimulus (it overrides the file's power) and
logged as laserPowerMw. Bonsai reads the same file to list its conditions (stimLocations01, stimLocations02, ...). Every trial of
an optogenetics experiment sends Zapit a condition: laser-on trials with the laser on, all others as laser-off trials
with the laser off, so galvo noise and masking light are the same on every trial. "Stimulus" is the tone and
grating; the laser is continuous: it starts at the trial's start (beep 0: the trigger pulse on a hardware-triggered
rig), laser_leads_stimulus_by_seconds before the first tone pip, and Bonsai stops it at the trial's outcome, or after
laser_max_seconds if that comes first. Zapit's host,
port and triggering are rig.yml's zapit block.

useZapit.description: Whether Zapit runs this experiment: every trial sends it a condition, laser on or off, and rig-control checks Zapit is answering before Go
useZapit.title: UseZapit

zapitConfigPath.description: Path to the Zapit conditions file loaded in Zapit. Its top-level stimLocations01, stimLocations02, ... entries are the conditions: numbered 1 to N with no gaps, each with an offRampDownDuration_ms of at least 100 ms
zapitConfigPath.title: ZapitConfigPath

laserPowerMw.description: Laser power on laser-on trials, in mW, the same for every condition: sent to Zapit with each StartStimulus (overriding the conditions file's power; Zapit's laser calibration turns it into volts) and logged as laserPowerMw (0 on laser-off trials). Required with optogenetics on
laserPowerMw.title: LaserPowerMw

laserOnProbability.description: Probability that a trial after trials_before_laser is a laser-on trial, shared equally by every condition in the Zapit conditions file, a laser-on control site included. All other trials are laser-off trials: Zapit is sent a condition with the laser off. Conditions come from shuffled queues, one for laser-on and one for laser-off trials, so each is used equally often
laserOnProbability.title: LaserOnProbability

laserMaxSeconds.description: Longest the laser stays on in one trial, in seconds from its onset, timed by Bonsai; it then ramps down over the condition's offRampDownDuration_ms. A safety cap: the laser normally stops at the trial's outcome. With optogenetics on it must be at least trialStructure.timeLimitSeconds (the time limit, 12 s) + laser_leads_stimulus_by_seconds + 0.25 s, so it never ends a timed-out trial's laser early; on a stage without timeLimit a longer trial loses its laser before the outcome
laserMaxSeconds.title: LaserMaxSeconds

laserLeadsStimulusBySeconds.description: How long the laser is on before the stimulus (the first tone pip and grating frame) starts, in seconds: a multiple of the 50 ms beep, from 0.05 to 0.2. The first pip moves to beep laser_leads_stimulus_by_seconds / 50 ms on every trial of an optogenetics experiment, laser-on or laser-off, so trial timing does not reveal laser-on trials. At most 0.2 s: licks before the first pip count toward the wrong-lick limits, and a longer lead could end a trial before its first pip
laserLeadsStimulusBySeconds.title: LaserLeadsStimulusBySeconds

trialsBeforeLaser.description: Trials at the experiment's start with no laser-on trial among them (each still sends Zapit a condition at 0 mW). laser_on_probability applies from the next trial
trialsBeforeLaser.title: TrialsBeforeLaser

OptogeneticsConfig.title: OptogeneticsConfig

rewardFloorHz.description: Lower frequency of the reward zone, in Hz
rewardFloorHz.title: RewardFloorHz

rewardCeilingHz.description: Upper frequency of the reward zone, in Hz
rewardCeilingHz.title: RewardCeilingHz

rewardSizeUl.title: RewardSizeUl

lickToReward.description: Whether a lick in the zone earns the reward; false rewards reaching the zone, no lick needed

wrongLickLimit.description: Licks outside the zone that end the trial; 0: wrong licks never end it
wrongLickLimit.title: WrongLickLimit

punishWrongZone.description: Whether a trial that ends outside the reward zone is punished. A trial that runs out of time or track with the frequency in the zone is punished on every stage
punishWrongZone.title: PunishWrongZone

quiescent.description: Whether the next trial waits for trialStructure.quiescentSeconds without licks
quiescent.title: Quiescent

timeLimit.description: Whether a trial ends at trialStructure.timeLimitSeconds
timeLimit.title: TimeLimit

trackEndEndsTrial.description: Whether reaching the end of the track ends the trial
trackEndEndsTrial.title: TrackEndEndsTrial

trackLengthScale.description: The drawn track length is multiplied by this
trackLengthScale.title: TrackLengthScale

frequencyDrift.description: Whether the frequency also drifts up with time, not only with distance run
frequencyDrift.title: FrequencyDrift

truncatedTrialFraction.description: Fraction of trials whose stimulus switches off early (truncation.sweepFractions)
truncatedTrialFraction.title: TruncatedTrialFraction

TrainingStage.title: TrainingStage

itiMinSeconds.description: Lower bound of the uniformly drawn inter-trial interval, in seconds
itiMinSeconds.title: ItiMinSeconds

itiMaxSeconds.description: Upper bound of the uniformly drawn inter-trial interval, in seconds
itiMaxSeconds.title: ItiMaxSeconds

quiescentSeconds.description: On a stage with quiescent, the next trial waits until the mouse has gone this long without licking (uncapped), so licks for the last reward cannot carry into the next trial
quiescentSeconds.title: QuiescentSeconds

timeLimitSeconds.description: On a stage with timeLimit, the longest a trial runs from its start, in seconds (av-dome's response period is its closedLoopSeconds)
timeLimitSeconds.title: TimeLimitSeconds

trackLengthsCm.description: Track lengths, one drawn per trial and scaled by the stage's trackLengthScale, in cm
trackLengthsCm.title: TrackLengthsCm

Truncation.description:
Where the stimulus switches off on a truncated trial (a stage's truncatedTrialFraction says how many).

On a truncated trial the stimulus (tone and grating) switches off part way along the sweep. Everything else about
the trial is unchanged, so it is still rewarded as normal: the animal has to keep going and find the reward
zone without the stimulus.

sweepFractions.description: Where the stimulus switches off, as a fraction of the sweep on a log scale, split evenly over truncated trials. The reward floor is at about 0.8
sweepFractions.title: SweepFractions

Truncation.title: Truncation

rngSeed.title: RngSeed

modality.description: What the trial shows: the tone sweep (auditory), the grating (visual) or both (audiovisual)
modality.title: Modality

sweepStartHz.description: Start frequency of the sweep (Hz). The tone files in src/waveforms are made for this value: the workflow stops at Go if they differ
sweepStartHz.title: SweepStartHz

sweepEndHz.description: End frequency of the sweep (Hz). The tone files in src/waveforms are made for this value: the workflow stops at Go if they differ
sweepEndHz.title: SweepEndHz

sweepSteps.description: Number of frequency bins for quantization. The tone files in src/waveforms are made for this value: the workflow stops at Go if they differ
sweepSteps.title: SweepSteps

toneAmplitude.description: Tone amplitude (0.0 to 1.0). The tone files in src/waveforms are made for this value: the workflow stops at Go if they differ
toneAmplitude.title: ToneAmplitude

backgroundNoiseLevel.description: Constant background white noise RMS, as a fraction of the beep RMS (0 = off)
backgroundNoiseLevel.title: BackgroundNoiseLevel

positionStepCm.description: The distance run is rounded to this before it sets the frequency, in cm
positionStepCm.title: PositionStepCm

wheelDiameterMm.description: Wheel diameter the task converts encoder counts to cm with, replacing rig.yml's behaviorBoard runningWheel wheelDiameterMm; null uses rig.yml's. Tom Childs' workflow converted at 75 mm while every corridor rig's rig.yml says 170 mm, so 75 keeps each track the number of wheel turns the mice trained on until the real diameter is settled
wheelDiameterMm.title: WheelDiameterMm
